name: Machiya Kazushi
source:
High school student at St. Chiffon Academy.
Likes: Fun Things
Dislikes: Hard Work

A high class kid whose dad is the president of a large company.
He has a bright and non serious personality. 
He never runs away from romance situations, but he hasn't ever truly loved anyone yet.
